items.title: Kraken’s parent Payward is betting billions on becoming financial infrastructure, not just a crypto exchange
items.summary: Kraken parent Payward is unifying trading, payments, asset management and institutional services on common rails, co-CEO Arjun Sethi said.

items.title: Binance deal gives Circle a boost in stablecoin race with Tether, analysts say
items.summary: The five-year deal could strengthen USDC’s reach in emerging markets, though Tether’s liquidity advantage remains hard to dislodge, analysts told CoinDesk.

items.title: Bitget hacker moves $83 million in stolen XRP that Ripple cannot freeze
items.summary: Two wallets have been almost emptied and a third is being drained, with about $75 million remaining across the five original holding accounts.

items.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
items.summary: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

items.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
items.summary: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.
